item.subject: science
item.stem: Meena swallows a bite of chapati at her home in Jaipur. Her teacher asks her how the food travels down her food pipe (oesophagus) to her stomach. Which statement correctly explains this movement?

options.A: The walls of the food pipe contract and relax in waves, pushing the food down to the stomach.
options.B: The food simply falls down into the stomach because of gravity once it is swallowed.
options.C: The tongue pushes the food all the way down the food pipe into the stomach.
options.D: Acid from the stomach rises up and pulls the food down through the food pipe.
